name: atlan-analytics
description: Bootstrap metrics and saved SQL queries, build a talk-to-data agent, evaluate it and improve it against your Snowflake or Databricks warehouse, on the Atlan registry.

interface.shortDescription: Metrics and talk-to-data agents on Atlan
interface.longDescription: The analytics workload on the Atlan registry. Mine your warehouse's query history into governed metrics and saved queries, build a talk-to-data agent that reads them, measure it against a local eval set and improve it round by round, or propose a metric fix from a conversation. It finds your Snowflake, Databricks or other warehouse through Atlan or your own connector, and asks you to connect one when it is missing. It uses the Atlan plugin's connection; building and evaluating an agent needs Claude Code.
defaultPrompt: Build metrics and saved queries for our support tables from the warehouse's query history
Build a talk-to-data agent for our revenue questions
Propose a fix for the metric we just found was wrong
